children: Wedbush Securities launched new analyst coverage of the cybersecurity sector on Friday with a positive stance on AI-native platform vendors and a negative stance on standalone vulnerability management vendors.

Analyst Steven Wahrhaftig noted the firm's view is not that AI-driven threat escalation converts into larger cybersecurity budgets, but rather that the budget is being redistributed. "With this spending concentrated across some platforms, we note that vendor results are now starting to show that a handful of cyber platforms are emerging as long-term winners," he wrote.

Wahrhaftig and his team highlighted five new themes reshaping cyber budget allocation over the coming years: AI vs. AI defense becomes the default posture across all layers of the tech stack, platform consolidation, data as the perimeter, observability as infrastructure, and vulnerability management disruption.
As far as stock picks, Wedbush initiated Palo Alto Networks
with Outperform ratings and added them to the firm's Best Ideas List. CrowdStrike Holdings
were also started at Outperform, while Tenable Holdings
was initiated with an Underperform rating.
were all downgraded to Neutral from Outperform.
